# pipegx

pipegx inspects a build pipeline DAG for unknown steps, cycles, duplicate
artifacts and unproduced goals. Part of gxkit; the inspect contract (stable
codes, exit codes, a storyboard) is shared.

- Install/run: uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/pipegx" pipegx inspect pipe.py
- Write: a Python file building pipegx.Pipeline(steps=[pipegx.Step("build", produces=["app"])], goals=["app"]); or STEPS / GOALS / NAME.
- A step is Step(name, needs=[...], produces=[...]).
- pipegx inspect pipe.py — exit 1 on any error; --json; --no-storyboard; -o name.png.
- Codes: unknown-step (error), cycle (error), duplicate-step (error), duplicate-artifact (error), goal-not-produced (error), no-steps (info), no-goals (info).
